safety_verdicts.content: Patient presents with lip swelling for the past 1 hour.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts note lip swelling but do not include the duration ('past 1 hour').
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the duration of lip swelling removes an important time-course detail that helps judge acuity and likelihood of anaphylaxis versus other causes. While lip swelling is still documented, loss of the “past 1 hour” detail could delay appropriate escalation/triage in some contexts.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: No dizziness is documented in the generated facts.

Missing it could lead to underestimation of severity and insufficient escalation.
